entry.name: AI for Everyone
entry.note: A non-technical course on what AI can and cannot do inside an organisation
entry.audience: Managers, executives and anyone working alongside technical teams

reading.cost: The page states that you can join for free. It also refers to buying a Certificate, which gives access to all course materials including graded assignments, and to a subscription that unlocks more than 10,000 courses, but it gives no price.
covers: Common AI terms such as neural networks, machine learning, deep learning and data science
What AI can and cannot realistically do
Spotting opportunities to apply AI in your own organization
What building machine learning and data science projects is like
Working with an AI team and building an AI strategy
Ethical and societal questions around AI
Choosing an AI project and the workflow of a machine learning project
How every job function needs to use data
reading.format: An online course on Coursera, listed as beginner level and available in 27 languages. The page groups the material into sections with total running times and marks some items as optional. Graded assignments form part of the course, and on completion an electronic Certificate is added to the learner's Accomplishments page, where it can be printed or added to a LinkedIn profile.
reading.summary: AI for Everyone is an online course from DeepLearning.AI offered on Coursera. It explains common AI terms and sets out what AI can and cannot do, then looks at how organizations can find and run AI projects. The page describes the course as largely non-technical and aimed at people who want their organization to use AI better. Finishing the course and its graded assignments leads to an electronic Certificate.
reading.audience: The page says it is for anyone who wants their organization to get better at using AI, especially non-technical colleagues. It adds that engineers can take it as well, to learn the business side of AI.
reading.prerequisites: The page lists the course as beginner level and does not state any required or recommended background.
